stances.summary: Emphasizes commitment to preserving small-town Ohio character
stances.quote: Small-town Ohio is what makes our state special & we’re going to keep it that way. ❤️

stances.summary: Criticizes opponent for lack of action or commitment
stances.quote: It’s really a shame my opponent hasn’t done that even once.

stances.summary: Expresses gratitude to Ohio constituents for support

stances.summary: Calls for lower property taxes in November election
stances.quote: Vote for lower property taxes this November. 🍋

stances.summary: Criticizes current system functioning
stances.quote: This is not how the system is supposed to work.

stances.summary: Outlines gubernatorial campaign priorities
stances.quote: Here are the first three things I’ll do as governor.

stances.summary: Emphasizes commitment to serving Ohio constituents
stances.quote: Serving Ohio. 😉

stances.summary: Reaching out to Black voters differently than Democrats or Republicans
stances.quote: A good morning meeting with black pastors and community leaders in downtown Cincinnati. Democrats take black voters for granted, many Republicans are reluctant to reach out. We’re doing it differently than both.

stances.summary: Criticizes opponent's comparison of law enforcement to KKK, touts police/sheriff endorsements
stances.quote: My opponent compares law enforcement to the KKK (yes that’s real). I’m grateful to have the support of both police & sheriffs across the state, she made the choice a little too obvious.

stances.summary: Praises Ohio and its people as exemplary
stances.quote: Here’s what makes a great state, at the heart of the greatest nation: the people of Ohio.

stances.summary: Emphasizes economic prosperity and bipartisan outreach to Ohio communities
stances.quote: An honest and transparent discussion with Black business & community leaders from across northeast Ohio, convening in Cleveland today. Economic prosperity unites us & we’re ready to deliver for Ohioans across the state, regardless of political party.

stances.summary: Outlines Ohio state priorities: property tax relief, data center legislation, Medicaid fraud prosecution
stances.quote:
Day 1 priorities:
1. Property tax relief
2. Data center legislation
3. Prosecute Medicaid fraud & return billions to Ohioans

Go big & go early, with the broader agenda to follow.

stances.summary: Advocates for cutting property taxes
stances.quote: Replying to @MJisTHEBEST This is why cutting property taxes matters.

stances.summary: Proposes energy production, housing deregulation, Medicaid fraud prosecution for affordability
stances.quote: Here’s how to actually deliver affordability, rather than just uttering the word. Bring down electric bills by producing more energy. Bring down housing prices by cutting red tape for new home construction. Prosecute Medicaid fraud that inflates healthcare costs.

stances.summary: Advocates for lower taxes and reduced utility costs
stances.quote: Lower property taxes. Lower electric bills. Bigger after-tax paychecks.

stances.summary: Supports dairy industry investment and job creation in Ohio
stances.quote: The economics of being a farmer in Ohio aren’t easy, but it doesn’t have to stay that way. More dairy processors coming to Ohio means high-paying jobs & more demand for milk produced on our dairy farms. That’s how economic development & supporting our farmers can go toget

stances.summary: Business experience better serves farmer economic interests
stances.quote: It takes a businessman at the top to really understand how to help our farmers economically.

stances.summary: Blames pandemic spending and closures for inflation and learning loss

stances.quote: The right way to bring down the cost of housing is to build more homes by cutting red tape & land use restrictions. The right way to cut electric bills is to produce more energy & deliver the benefits straight to ratepayers.

stances.summary: Blames government spending for affordability crisis, advocates energy production and housing supply
stances.quote: The affordability challenges in Ohio & across America are directly a consequence of the exact same policies that the new socialists now advocate for: more government spending. The right answer is more energy production, increasing the supply of housing, slashing property taxes, a

stances.summary: Proposes slashing property taxes and eliminating income tax to reduce costs
stances.quote: Put more $$ in the pockets of Ohioans to bring down costs. Slash property taxes & eliminate the income tax. Coming right after we win. 💪🏽

stances.summary: Identifies energy abundance and workforce development as economic growth priorities
stances.quote: Energy abundance & workforce developments are two keys to supercharging Ohio’s economy.

stances.summary: Promises to attract advanced manufacturing to Ohio through gubernatorial election
stances.quote: There’s an advanced manufacturing boom waiting to come into our state if we elect the right Governor

stances.summary: Challenges opponent's fitness for office, demands debate participation
stances.quote: Just publicly accepted a third debate invitation on live TV tonight. If Acton can’t debate, she certainly can’t lead the state. https://t.co/gsCfve4eZ8

stances.summary: Challenges opponent to participate in debate forums

stances.summary: Encourages supporters to purchase campaign yard signs
stances.quote: Get your yard sign today!

stances.summary: Challenges opponent in competitive electoral race
stances.quote: A friendly challenge to my opponent.

stances.summary: Contrasts own accessibility and responsiveness with unnamed opponent's approach
stances.quote: Voters deserve a leader who answers real questions & that’s what we’re doing every day now through November.

stances.summary: Criticizes unnamed opponent for not engaging directly with voters
stances.quote: She should show up & answer to voters, just like I am.

stances.summary: Challenges Amy Acton to answer unscripted voter questions publicly
stances.quote: My challenge to @amyactonoh: show up to a county fair and take unscripted questions from voters, just like I’m doing nearly every day.

stances.summary: Encourages youth political engagement and family mobilization
stances.quote: A group of 16-year-olds asked how they can help. Can’t vote yet, but they can still get their families out!

stances.summary: Contrasts own accessibility with opponent's approach to constituent engagement
stances.quote: Butler County fair on Wednesday, Lima last night, Clermont County fair tonight. Unlike my opponent, we’re taking open questions at fairs across the state. 💪🏼

stances.summary: Supports voter ID requirement as constitutional amendment, criticizes Democratic opposition
stances.quote: Government-issued photo ID should be a requirement to vote, period. It’s common sense & predictably the Ohio Democrat Party leadership opposes it. Vote YES on the Voter ID constitutional amendment in November.

stances.summary: Frames American Dream as central to Trump movement values
stances.quote: We’re grateful for it: the American Dream. 🙏

stances.summary: Opposes socialism, invokes American greatness narrative
stances.quote: A man who remembers what made America great & who knows it wasn’t socialism.

stances.summary: Contrasts entrepreneurial leadership with bureaucratic governance
stances.quote:
An entrepreneur vs. a bureaucrat. 

Someone who answers voter questions vs. someone who hides from them.

An abundance mentality vs. a scarcity mentality.

Economic success vs. socialist devastation.

stances.summary: Positions self as problem-solving entrepreneur, not politician
stances.quote: I’m not a politician, I’m an entrepreneur who believes in solving problems.

stances.summary: Contrasts economic growth vision with progressive stagnation narrative
stances.quote: Two very different visions for the future. Economic success vs. grievance. Upward mobility vs. stagnation. Ascent vs. decline.

stances.summary: Implies policy approach will improve quality of life
stances.quote: This is how we’re actually going to improve your lives. 🇺🇸 🇺🇸

stances.summary: Criticizes socialism's growing popularity in America
stances.quote: A woman named Lyla in New Philadelphia, OH, asked me why socialism is gradually becoming more popular in our country. It’s a great question, and here’s what I told her.

stances.summary: Opposes wokeness, gender ideology, grievance politics, and socialism
stances.quote: Great to join pastors, religious leaders, and activists in Middletown yesterday at the Ohio Faith & Freedom Forum. Faith, family, patriotism, & hard work beats wokeness, gender ideology, grievance, and socialism.

stances.summary: Celebrates traditional community gathering, cultural heritage preservation
stances.quote: Enjoyed walking around in Little Italy’s Feast of the Assumption in Cleveland today. It’s a decades-old tradition that brings the entire community together, celebrates Italian-American heritage, and reminds us of what makes America great.

stances.summary: Promotes faith, family, patriotism, hard work as superior values
stances.quote: Faith, family, patriotism, and hard work beat the alternatives. An inspiring afternoon today at Apostolic Gospel Church in Portsmouth, Ohio.

stances.summary: Frames socialism as rejection of American Dream
stances.quote: The rise of socialism is, at its core, a rejection of the idea of the American Dream itself.

stances.summary: Emphasizes agriculture's importance to Ohio economy
stances.quote: Agriculture is the backbone of Ohio.

stances.summary: Promotes visiting family farms, emphasizes agricultural community engagement
stances.quote: Continuing to visit family farms across the state. 🇺🇸

stances.summary: Supports youth agricultural education programs
stances.quote: It was an honor to kick off the annual steer show at the state fair. Committed to continually backing the 4-H & FFA programs to get our young people into agricultural careers. 💪🏼

stances.summary: Promotes agricultural community engagement
stances.quote: Great to meet Ohio’s farming legends at the 60th Annual Ohio Agricultural Hall of Fame Breakfast! Enjoying my third straight day here at the state fair. 🎡

stances.summary: Economic development and agriculture support are compatible goals
stances.quote: Economic development & support for agriculture actually go together, if they’re done correctly. Great visit to the Hord farm today, a fifth-generation family farm that represents the best of our state.

stances.summary: Farmers are essential to Ohio's economy and deserve support
stances.quote: Farmers are the backbone of our state & we’ll always have your back. Great to speak with a group of farmers in Bucyrus tonight, headed there straight from the state fair.

stances.summary: Supports Ohio farmers and preservation of farmland
stances.quote: Great to visit the Ohio state fair & celebrate our oldest and most iconic industry: agriculture. We’re fully behind the farmers of Ohio, including to preserve our fertile farmland.

stances.summary: Promotes plan to make homeownership affordable for young people
stances.quote: Young people say it’s too hard to afford a home & they’re right. Here’s my plan to fix it.

stances.summary: Proposes plan to address young Americans' housing affordability crisis
stances.quote: Young Americans Can’t Afford Homes. Here’s How We Fix It.

stances.quote:

stances.summary: Proposes slashing property taxes and cutting construction regulations to aid affordability
stances.quote: The #1 question I get from voters in their 20s is how we can make home ownership more affordable. Two answers: slash property taxes & cut red tape that gets in the way of new home construction.

stances.summary: Addresses cutting property taxes while maintaining education funding
stances.quote: Jillian from Hamilton asked the same question I got from another woman earlier on at the fair: how can we cut property taxes & improve education at the same time? Here’s the answer.

stances.summary: Offers back-to-school guidance to Ohio families
stances.quote: It’s back to school season. Here’s my advice to Ohio families.

stances.summary: Criticizes school closures and learning loss, opposes official's promotion
stances.quote: This is a moral failure that betrays our kids & it comes right after the Covid school closures that resulted in irreparable learning loss. Now the woman who caused the problem wants a job promotion. Can’t make this stuff up.

stances.summary: Opposes excessive bureaucracy in schools
stances.quote: Pro-student & pro-teacher policy go together. Too much bureaucracy harms both.

stances.summary: Proposes cutting property taxes while improving schools
stances.quote: A public school teacher in Butler County asked me a fair question: how can we cut property taxes while also improving schools for our children? Here’s what I told her.

stances.summary: Supporting veterans better is a moral duty
stances.quote: Met a Vietnam-era veteran in Holmes County & asked her what we could do to better support our veterans. It’s a moral duty.

stances.summary: Pledges support for Ohio veterans and Gold Star families
stances.quote: We will always honor & support the veterans & Gold Star families across Ohio. Grateful to welcome a group of them to my home today where we discussed how our state can do better in the future.

stances.summary: Expresses gratitude for military service
stances.quote: We’re grateful for his service to our country. 🙏 🇺🇸

stances.summary: Honors Gold Star families and military sacrifice
stances.quote: Never forget about Gold Star. Live from Evendale, OH.

stances.summary: Criticizes law enforcement by comparing to KKK

stances.summary: Calls for restoring law and order in cities

stances.summary: Criticizes Amy Acton's claim about COVID death rate as false
stances.quote: Amy Acton claims that the COVID death rate was 50% (when in fact it was less than 1%).

stances.summary: Criticizes Ohio health officials Platner and Acton over COVID response
stances.quote: From Platner to Acton.

stances.summary: Claims COVID death rate exceeded 50%, criticizes Fauci
stances.quote: She claims the Covid death was over 50%. Worse than Fauci. Just listen for yourself.

stances.summary: Entrepreneur background qualifies him to reform healthcare system
stances.quote: I’m not a politician, I’m an entrepreneur who believes in solving problems. My company Roivant developed five drugs which are FDA-approved & helping patients & saving lives across the country. And now we need to fix a healthcare system to help millions more.

stances.summary: Discusses veteran healthcare struggles, implies need for reform
stances.quote: A veteran asked me how to help address healthcare struggles like the ones his family has gone through. Here’s what I told him. We’re grateful for his service to our country. 🙏 🇺🇸

stances.summary: Presents data center policy plan without elaboration or argument
stances.quote: A man asked about my plan to address data centers. I laid out my plan without mincing words.

stances.summary: Advocates for unscripted, unfiltered conversation format
stances.quote: Good conversation. Unscripted, unfiltered, need more of this.

stances.summary: Defends Second Amendment as fundamental right
stances.quote: The Second Amendment isn’t a recommendation. It’s a right & it shall not be infringed. 🇺🇸 🇺🇸

stances.summary: Reaches out to Black community leaders, emphasizes inclusive Republican outreach
stances.quote: Grateful for our tour across the state, meeting with Black pastors and community leaders. They lead congregations who rightfully want to secure a better life for their families. They may not be traditional Republicans, but we’re in this for everyone. 🙏
